{"file_path": "/app/prepare_fasttext.py", "content": "import pyarrow.parquet as pq
import sys

def convert_parquet_to_fasttext(input_path, output_path):
    table = pq.read_table(input_path, columns=['label', 'text'])
    labels = table.column('label')
    texts = table.column('text')

    with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        for i in range(table.num_rows):
            label_val = labels[i].as_py()
            text_val = texts[i].as_py()
            # fasttext label format
            label_line = f"__label__{label_val} {text_val}\n"
            f.write(label_line)

    print(f"Converted {table.num_rows} rows to {output_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    convert_parquet_to_fasttext("/app/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet", "/app/train.txt")
